stop_temperature: 0 when audio T=0, otherwise fixed 1; stop logits never CFG-guided
generation: Natural stop/continue, no forced minimum length; 5.5-second hint plus 60-frame safety budget. Batch size 4. No Luna, no LoRA, all takes retained.
selection_rule: Within each prompt format: eligible if mean RAW conventional WER <= 0.10 and mean processed genuineness >= same-format CFG=1.5,T=1 baseline minus 0.25. Maximize mean target-emotion rank percentile; ties within 0.01 prefer higher direction CLAP. If no eligible configuration, explicitly report no qualifying optimum and present Pareto trade-offs.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over 10 emotion-format blocks, averaging the two seeds within each block. Only five emotions and one English utterance: intervals are descriptive, not population guarantees. T=0 seeds are duplicates, not independent replications.
holdout_plan: After the main grid: baseline plus up to three shortlisted settings, same five emotions/formats/two seeds, separately German utterance with reference A and English utterance with reference B. This is a selected-setting generalization check, NOT a full independent grid search.

metrics.primary_wer: Unicode-aware Levenshtein word error rate on raw PCM using Parakeet v3; errors may exceed 100% with insertions.
metrics.post_wer: Same ASR/WER after production forced alignment and fades; secondary, to expose tail trimming effects.
metrics.naturalness: VoiceCLAP-commercial Genuineness full head 0-6 on processed PCM; proxy, not listener MOS.
metrics.emotion: Empathic-Insight-Voice-Small 40 heads, documented ReLU and EmoWhisper-AnS-Small-v0.1 encoder; target rank percentile (40-rank)/39 and raw target score, neither calibrated probability.
metrics.direction: Centered VoiceCLAP-commercial cosine against exactly the requested acting direction; separate correlated proxy.
metrics.blend: Existing 0-10 vocal-burst blend head as diagnostic only; these prompts contain no explicit bursts.

diagnostic_plan: Added after observing main-grid failure: 160 takes with terse per-sentence cues and explicit sentence durations, same full global direction/text/reference/seeds. Exploratory recipe rescue, not an untouched holdout; multiple recipe details change. Also 20 original-backend baseline takes (CFG1.5,T1) for numerical-optimization quality diagnostics, not a powered equivalence trial.

A.note: Positive-valence-labelled corpus speech. Not a neutral-speaker control.

B.note: Hiss-labelled corpus take containing speech. Possible burst/timbre contamination; this is a reference-sensitivity stress check, not a neutral clean-reference replication.

reference_provenance.preparation: Leading-silence removal at -45 dB, first 2.88 s, mono 48 kHz. Neither clip contains the target utterance. No reference audio is served publicly.
